answer: Mechanism: deposit + arbitration forfeiture. Every identity MUST lock 50 USDC in the PEARL-scripted escrow before it can vote/grade. Each lock emits a registration plume (txid broadcast) into the mempool river. A farm of 1000 clones pays 1000 × 50 = 50,000 USDC and forfeits the entire 50,000 USDC the moment arbitration flags the clone pattern. Honesty stays cheaper.
